QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] A Question of Scale
QuestInfo.0: Ask Beatrice what she learned from the Tower Fragments.
QuestInfo.1: The castle in the sky is part of a gigantic pentacle? A pentacle that big would cover all of Kritias! What kind of magic is the Black Mage dealing with here?\r\nReport what you've discovered to Neinheart in Ereve.
QuestInfo.2: The castle in the sky was the center of a giant pentacle. You turned in your report on Kritias to Neinheart.

0.0:
Just as I feared... Kritias's castle is the pentacle. 
Or rather, it's the #bcenter of the pentacle#k.
#L0##bWait, just how big is this pentacle thing?#l
#k
0.1: Based on these auric reverberations, the pentacle covers the entire kingdom. The Black Mage is trying to convert #ball of Kritias into a pentacle#k.\r\n#L0# #bWh-what would he need a pentacle that big for?!#l\n#k
0.2: It's hard to say. Size doesn't necessarily equal power, but it's no ordinary spell he's weaving, that's certain. A pentacle that size could affect the fate of all of Maple World.\r\n#L0# #bMaybe... Is that related to why Kritias reappeared in Maple World?#l\n#k
0.3: ...No, we currently don't have proof of a definite relationship. However... all magic users in Kritias can feel it. #bThe magic in Kritias is disappearing to somewhere.#k Kritias reappearing in Maple World coincides with when we perceived that.\r\n#L0# #bMagic is disappearing... to somewhere?#l\n#k
0.4: Yes, I'm sure. This is ridiculous... Please, I beg you. Return to Ereve and tell them what's happening. Surely they will help us!

yes.0: This #bMagic Orb#k will teleport you to Ereve. Please, hurry. Who knows when the Black Mage will show his hand?

no.0: No... You aren't abandoning us to our fate, are you? After you've come this far with us? We must brave this together! If for no other reason, think of your karma!

1.0: I was wondering when you'd be back. Report.

yes.0: Converting an entire kingdom into a massive pentacle? Outrageous.

npc.0: If the Black Mage completes this pentacle, it'll be unlike anything we've ever seen before. Please let Neinheart in Ereve know.
